name: Bloons Tower Defense 3
author: Addicting Games
description: Bloons Tower Defense 3 is a free tower defense game. create an impressive armada of defensive monkeys to clear the waves of balloons before they can reach the end of the path. If balloons were to ever rise up against their human creators, then this game gives us a good blueprint for winning the insurrection. Get a few good monkeys, give them bangarangs, and listen as the balloons pop one by one by one.
